description: This Java source file defines the Spring Boot configuration class 'Config' for the Sigfox adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It sets up bean definitions, configuration properties, validation, and metrics customization related to the Sigfox adapter implementation.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the Sigfox adapter, handling bean creation, configuration validation, and metrics setup.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Runs after construction to validate that the Sigfox Protocol Adapter is configured with authentication required.

methods.name: sigfoxProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of SigfoxProtocolAdapter bean.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name for downstream sender client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name for registration client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name for credentials client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name for tenant client factory if not already set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the Sigfox adapter from application configuration.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Provides a factory for creating instances of the SigfoxProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures metrics registry with common tags specific to the Sigfox protocol adapter.
